$comment: infra-only branch: objective score ≡ daily_life (shops, cafés, doctors, schools). Other pillars stay in the contract at weight 0 so exports and UI types do not drift. Consumed by the Python pipeline, the frontend scoring engine and the Go services. Run `make contract-check` after edits.

informational_pillars.$comment: Exported and shown in the UI but weighted 0 in the objective score.

walk_minute_bands.$comment: Piecewise [minutes, score] knots. Python interpolates the same knots in score_scales.walk_minute_band_score; the frontend uses them as ACCESSIBILITY_BANDS.default.
